Renal oncocytomas (ROs) are benign epithelial tumors of the kidney that may progress into malignant chromophobe renal cell carcinoma (chRCCs), with the latter constituting 5 – 7 % of renal neoplasias.

material_type.evidence: We employed formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded samples (six RO cases, six chRCC cases) together with isotopic triplex dimethylation and a pooled reference standard to enable cohort-wide quantitative comparison.

sample_source.evidence: FFPE tissue specimens of six ROs and six chRCCs were used as described previously, including microscopically controlled macrodissection to remove areas of necrosis, fibrosis, hemorrhage, and inflammation.
